title: Can the questions move less?
hook: Offline questions can travel through an array in a different order.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Reorder offline interval queries into blocks so a maintained window moves fewer times.

misconception: Queries must be processed in arrival order even when no updates occur.
objective: Reorder offline interval queries into blocks so a maintained window moves fewer times.

claims.text: Offline queries can be reordered because no update changes the underlying values. The maintained frequency table reuses the current interval as its endpoints move; the answers are stored by original query identity.
